runtime_profile_summary: Rust stable toolchain via rustup with cargo package manager. System dependencies: git, curl, pkg-config, libasound2-dev, libudev-dev, libwayland-dev, libxkbcommon-dev, ca-certificates, build-essential, libssl-dev.
test_runner_reachability_evidence:
cargo 1.96.0 (30a34c682 2026-05-25)
rustc 1.96.0 (ac68faa20 2026-05-25)
Cargo and Rustc are callable
activation_command: export RUSTUP_HOME=/opt/rustup && export CARGO_HOME=/opt/cargo && export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
notes: Environment specification created for Bevy Rust game engine v0.13.0. Setup script installs Rust stable toolchain via rustup and all required system dependencies for Linux development. Activation command exports RUSTUP_HOME, CARGO_HOME, and PATH environment variables. The test runner (cargo test) is reachable and callable. Note: The repository has a compilation issue with newer Rust versions due to stricter linting in bevy_mikktspace crate, but this is a code issue not an environment issue.
